# IMQLock.token() method

Returns the token identifying the current holder of a given key, or `undefined` when the key is not locked.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static token(key: string): number | undefined;
```

**Returns:**

## Remarks

Read it immediately after [IMQLock.acquire()](/api/rpc/latest/rpc.imqlock.acquire/) resolves and [IMQLock.locked()](/api/rpc/latest/rpc.imqlock.locked/) confirms you are the holder, then hand it back to [IMQLock.release()](/api/rpc/latest/rpc.imqlock.release/) — that is what proves the release is yours. There is no way to recover it later: once the deadlock timeout has freed the key, this returns the NEXT holder's token, which is exactly the confusion the token exists to prevent.
